## AI engineer & principal consultant — agentic systems that hold up in production

InertialRange Labs AB is the consulting practice of **Farrukh Nauman, PhD**. I design and ship AI-agent systems — Text-to-SQL, coding agents, evaluation harnesses, tool contracts — wired to production data platforms like BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks, and SQL databases.

I build the thing and write the code, with the test discipline and result-level evaluation that make agents trustworthy in production — not slide decks. When an engagement needs it, I also take **interim / fractional leadership** of data and AI teams.

### Offers

Two fixed-price offers, a monthly retainer, and time-based delivery.

- **Agent Reliability Audit** — fixed price, about 2 weeks: an eval suite on your data, a baseline, and a ranked list of fixes.
- **Agent Build Sprint** — fixed price, 4 to 6 weeks: one agent built to an acceptance test agreed in week one.
- **Reliability Retainer** — monthly: regression checks and reviews as models, prompts, and data change.
- **Embedded AI Engineering** — hourly or daily rate: a senior engineer or interim lead inside your team.

[See the offers →](engage.qmd)
